name: Currents API
tagline: Real-time news search and headlines from thousands of sources worldwide
description: Currents API provides real-time news data, latest headlines, and keyword search across thousands of global sources. Developers can query by language, category, region, and date, or fetch top stories, making it useful for news apps, alerts, and content aggregation.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter or Authorization header; free self-serve signup

pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available with higher limits; see pricing page for current tiers

rate_limits: 600 requests/day on free tier; higher on paid plans
use_cases: fetch latest headlines by language or category
get region-specific news for a country
power a news aggregator or alert bot
